content:
Parameter
Required?
Description
valid_secs
Optional
The number of seconds this activation code remains
valid. Default: 86400  (one day). Expiration not
supported for legacy phone platforms that support
passcode generation only (not Duo Push).
install
Optional
Specify 1  to also return an installation URL for Duo
Mobile; 0  to not return a URL. Default: 0 .
